tutorial_persistence_investigation.symptom: Tutorial progress ($IsTutorialProgress) resets to 0 on every relaunch

evidence_chain.significance: Game data save endpoint not implemented

root_cause_chain: Game queries POST /tutorial/* for tutorial completion state
Game has no local file persistence for this flag
On relaunch, game queries backend, receives no valid data, defaults to 0
contributing_factors: UserId = -1 (no authenticated player, free play mode)
No local file fallback (PlayerData1.sav never created)
Game design relies entirely on server-authoritative tutorial state
tutorial_persistence_investigation.causation_note: The HTTP 501 response is the proximate cause, but the game's complete absence of local fallback persistence and the UserId=-1 state are contributing factors. We do not claim any single factor as the sole root cause without direct branch evidence proving causation.

result_timeover_lose.description: Tutorial battle is scripted to time out (unwinnable by design)
result_timeover_lose.flow: FirstTimeTutorial -> Battle -> RequestEndBattle(Result_Timeover_Lose) -> LeaveMindWayBattle -> NoContinue -> TerminatedBattle -> Title
